in_pashto.name: اوشنه

Ushna's name suggests a lively and vibrant personality, much like the Arabian desert sun that never fails to captivate and inspire.

Ushna's name can be a source of inspiration and motivation to aspire to higher spiritual levels and to constantly seek the light of knowledge and wisdom in the service of God.
